description: Recall what VidLens already has stored from previous sessions — imported transcript and comment collections, downloaded media assets, and visual indexes. CALL THIS FIRST in a new session before searching or importing: unlike raw yt-dlp, VidLens imports persist across sessions and become searchable, so re-importing wastes time and API quota. Returns a compact digest with a hint on what to do next. [~instant]
name: recallWorkspace
